items.text: On November 16, 1981, Luke and Laura married on the soap opera General Hospital, the highest-rated hour in daytime television history.
items.question: Who did you watch Luke and Laura's wedding on General Hospital with, or who told you about it?
items.source_quote: November 16 – Luke and Laura marry on the U.S. soap opera General Hospital; it is the highest-rated hour in daytime television history.

items.text: MTV (Music Television) launched on cable television in the United States on August 1, 1981.
items.question: When did you first see MTV, and whose house were you at?
items.source_quote: August 1 – MTV (Music Television) is launched on cable television in the United States.

items.text: "Endless Love" by Diana Ross and Lionel Richie spent nine weeks at number one on the Billboard Hot 100 in 1981, the longest run at number one wholly within the year.
items.question: Where were you living when "Endless Love" was number one, and was it anyone's song in your life?
source_quote: The Billboard Hot 100 is a chart published since August 1958 by Billboard magazine which ranks the best-performing singles in the United States. In 1981, it was compiled based on a combination of sales and airplay data sourced from surveys of retail outlets and playlists submitted by radio stations, respectively. During the year, 17 different singles spent time at number one.
The longest run at number one wholly within 1981 was the nine weeks which "Endless Love" by Diana Ross and Lionel Richie spent atop the chart

items.text: On April 12, 1981, Space Shuttle Columbia, with John Young and Robert Crippen aboard, launched on the STS-1 mission, returning to Earth on April 14.
items.question: Where were you when Space Shuttle Columbia went up in April 1981, and who did you talk about it with?
items.source_quote: April 12 – The Space Shuttle program: Space Shuttle Columbia (John Young, Robert Crippen) launches on the STS-1 mission, returning to Earth on April 14.
